restrictions.brachycephalic_as_stated: Air Transat will not transport the following breeds or mixed breeds, including one or more of these: mastiffs (all breeds, including Dogo Argentino, Bandog, Boerboel, Fila Brasileiro, Cane Corso, Neapolitan, Presa Canario and Tosa Inu); pit bulls (all breeds, including American Bully, American Pit Bull Terrier, American Staffordshire Terrier and Staffordshire Bull Terrier); Akita; Caucasian Ovcharka; Kangal/Anatolian Shepherd (Karabash); Rottweiler; wolf-dog hybrids; and Doberman Pinscher. Bull Mastiffs and French Mastiffs (Dogue de Bordeaux) are exempt from that list and are accepted. For the hold, the official page also lists French Bulldogs and American Bulldogs among breeds it is unable to transport, and states that French Bulldogs are allowed in the cabin only. Other brachycephalic (snub-nosed) dogs and cats not on the refusal list are accepted in the hold only with extra conditions, including a kennel one size larger than the normal standard and ventilation openings on all four sides.

name: Iberia
hold_or_cargo_as_stated: Yes: cats and dogs in the hold, except snub-nosed dogs and dangerous breeds, up to 45 kg including the carrier, with prior authorisation through Iberia booking offices. The same carrier may hold two adult animals accustomed to living together and weighing no more than 14 kg each, or three animals less than 6 months old from the same litter. For connections, transit must be no less than 90 minutes and no more than 4 hours.
species_as_stated: Cabin: dogs, cats, tortoises and birds (except poultry and birds of prey), provided they do not exceed 8 kg including the carrier. Ornamental fish require prior authorisation from Iberia booking offices. Hold: cats and dogs only, except snub-nosed dogs and dangerous breeds. Animals in the weasel family (including ferrets and pine martens) are not transported.

cabin_max_weight.as_stated: Cabin: 8 kg including the carrier.

carrier_dimensions_as_stated: Cabin: maximum 45 cm (length) × 35 cm (width) × 25 cm (height), and the sum of these dimensions must not exceed 105 cm. On Iberia flights operated by Air Nostrum, the carrier cannot be rigid. Hold: aircraft limits vary; for Iberia Regional Air Nostrum flights the maximum dimensions are 83 cm × 65 cm × 56 cm.
hold_limits_as_stated: Hold: 45 kg (pet + carrier). Above 45 kg, or where legal or breed restrictions apply, transport is as cargo (Iberia directs customers to a cargo agent such as WOOF Airlines / IAG Cargo).
weight_as_stated: Cabin: 8 kg including the carrier. Hold: 45 kg (pet + carrier). Above 45 kg, or where legal or breed restrictions apply, transport is as cargo (Iberia directs customers to a cargo agent such as WOOF Airlines / IAG Cargo).

species_as_stated: As of 1 December 2025, pet transport is permitted only for dogs and cats, both in the cabin and in the hold. Reservations made by 30 November 2025 for other species in the cabin remain valid until those confirmed reservations are exhausted.

carrier_dimensions_as_stated: Cabin: a soft carrier placed under the seat in front, not exceeding 55 × 40 × 23 cm (maximum total 118 cm). Wheels must be removed or, if retractable, secured with adhesive tape.

service_animals_as_stated: Recognised guide and assistance dogs, regardless of breed or type, may travel in the cabin free of charge. A training certificate on letterhead (or with a legible stamp) from the training centre is required. The service must be requested at least 48 hours before departure. Service dogs are not subject to quotas. Emotional support dogs are not treated as trained assistance dogs and cannot travel free of charge; they follow the paid cabin or hold rules according to weight. Transportation remains free even if the dog must travel in the hold. The dog must stay under the passenger's direct control, may not sit on seats or stand near emergency exits, and a guide dog must remain in front of the owner's seat and wear a harness.

fees_as_stated: A non-refundable fee is charged for each flight segment when a reservation is made in advance; pets without an advance reservation are subject to a higher per-segment fee. The official Contract of Carriage (updated 1 January 2026) does not publish the dollar amounts.

restrictions.routes_as_stated: Pets are not accepted on international flights or on flights to or from Anchorage, Alaska; Hawaii; or Puerto Rico. Pets are not accepted for interline travel.

service_animals_as_stated: A service animal accompanying a passenger with a disability is accepted in the cabin without charge; it may not occupy a seat and must travel in the passenger's lap or foot space. A current U.S. DOT Service Animal Air Transportation Form is required, and for flight segments of eight hours or more a DOT Service Animal Relief Attestation Form is also required. If the reservation is made more than 48 hours before departure, the applicable form(s) must be submitted 48 hours in advance.
